summary: Mississippi lattice observation point at 31.2858, -91.0038 (about 127 m). Only OpenStreetMap found; its latest edit note says communication mast. No history or status found.

evidence.supports: latest edit note reads communication mast

notes_for_editor: Weakest of the three: one source only, the OSM node (tags: lattice, observation; ele 127; last edited over a year ago). The latest changeset note reads 'Add/modify communication mast.', which does not match the lookout tags, so the point may be a radio mast or a mislabelled node. A human should check the location before anything is published. Cached OSM data gives gnis:feature_id 705327; GNIS pages are JavaScript-only here and were not read. Two WebSearch calls returned nothing about a Stephenson tower in Mississippi (only the Moore Lookout Tower in Scott County and general material). The story is about 90 words, well below the usual 120-word floor. Consider holding it for human review rather than publishing as is. Page-read budget was exceeded (about 8 fetches, including repeats).
